item.title: TSMC-Sony image sensor venture pushes Japan chip investment to JPY6 trillion
item.summary: TSMC said on August 11 that it will invest in CMOS image sensor development and mass production with Sony Group in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, adding to a wave of foreign chip spending backed by Japanese subsidies. According to Nikkei Asia , Japan's total foreign investment in semiconductor plants has now reached JPY6 trillion (US$380 billion).
